title: Ridgeline Orders & Delivery Terms of Sale: Acceptance, Payment and Delivery Charges
content:
## Article 1. Acceptance

1.1 A Ridgeline Orders & Delivery order is accepted only when the merchandise total is at least the program's order minimum and the item meets the program's entry conditions.

1.2 A same-day order must be placed by the program's same-day order cutoff, local time.

## Article 2. Payment

2.1 The order is paid in full at placement on one of the tenders the program accepts. The merchandise total is billed to the order when the order is placed.

2.2 An order paid with a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account posts as a purchase on that account, and one paid with Ridgeline Pro Credit posts as an invoice.

## Article 3. Delivery charge and booked services

3.1 The delivery charge is the program's delivery or shipping charge, waived when the program's free-delivery threshold is above $0.00 and the merchandise total is at or above it, reduced by the delivery fee discount percentage of the customer's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership where the program is one to which the ProBuild Rewards delivery fee discount applies and the membership is active on the order date.

3.2 The delivery charge is billed with haul-away, at the program's haul-away charge and offered only where the program offers haul-away, and with basic install, at the program's basic install charge, when those services are booked. The membership discount is a reduction of the delivery charge; the haul-away and basic install charges are billed at the program's own figures.

**Waiver test (complete).**

| Program's free-delivery threshold | Merchandise total | Delivery charge before any membership discount |
|---|---|---|
| Above $0.00 | At or above the threshold | Waived, $0.00 |
| Above $0.00 | Below the threshold | The program's delivery or shipping charge |
| $0.00 | Any | The program's delivery or shipping charge |

**Worked example (hypothetical figures, not any program's terms).** Assume a program with a delivery charge of $60.00, a free-delivery threshold of $500.00, a haul-away charge of $40.00, and a membership discount of 25 percent.

- Merchandise total $320.00, no active membership, haul-away booked: the threshold is not reached, so the delivery charge is $60.00, billed with the haul-away charge of $40.00.
- Merchandise total $320.00, membership active on the order date, discount applicable to the program: the delivery charge is $60.00 reduced by 25 percent, that is $45.00; the haul-away charge stays $40.00.
- Merchandise total $500.00: the total is at the threshold, so the delivery charge is waived and is $0.00 whether or not a membership is active; a booked haul-away is still billed at $40.00.
- A membership that is not active on the order date reduces nothing.

## Article 4. Delivery area and window

Truck and same-day deliveries are made only within the program's largest delivery distance, in miles, of the fulfilling store, in a booked window of the program's delivery window hours.

## Article 5. Changes and promised timing

5.1 Items or quantities may be changed within the program's change window, in minutes, after the moment the order was placed.

5.2 A pickup order is ready within the program's pickup ready hours, and a shipped or scheduled order is promised the program's lead days after the order date.

## Article 6. Substitution and backorder

6.1 Where the program allows substitution, an out-of-stock item may be replaced only with the customer's consent.

6.2 An item on backorder more than the program's backorder days past the promised date cancels the order with a full refund.

## Article 7. Order status and order balance

An order's status is placed when it is created. It becomes ready when it is picked and staged for pickup, shipped by the carrier, or loaded for its delivery date; out for delivery when it leaves on the delivery truck or with the carrier's final-mile driver; and fulfilled when it is delivered, or when a ready order is picked up in store or at the curb. The order balance is what the customer owes on the order: the merchandise total, fees and refunds paid out add to it, and payments and credits reduce it; a negative balance means money is owed back to the customer.
